response.rationale: Reach z-score of 5.431 is an extreme deviation (>5 baseline SDs), indicating a genuine reach surge. CPM is essentially flat (z=-0.316), which rules out a price or competition shift as the driver — a bid/competition move would typically move CPM alongside reach. Own-action confound flag is False and OSA z-score is 0.0, so the harness's own prior bid/budget changes are unlikely to explain this. The pattern (large reach move, stable price, no self-action artifact) is most consistent with a real demand-side market shock.
